title: Dobbelt-Pi-hole canonical configuration
description: Private deployment input. Use tools/render_config.py for normalization and cross-instance validation; do not publish this file as browser configuration.

version.description: Configuration format version, independent of the application release version. The renderer and browser currently accept only format 1.

defaultLanguage.description: Initial interface language when the browser has no saved selection. auto uses supported browser preferences, then English.

servers.description: Configured Pi-hole instances in display order. The renderer also requires unique IDs and unique normalized API destinations across this array.

id.description: Stable instance identifier used for its colour and destination-bound route/session identity. Keep it unchanged when renaming or reordering the same instance.

label.description: Nonblank display name. The renderer enforces at most 120 Unicode code points after trimming and rejects control characters and unpaired surrogates.

apiUrl.description: Direct final HTTP(S) Pi-hole API base URL without credentials, query, fragment, escapes or dot segments. Requests do not follow redirects. The renderer checks host/port validity and duplicate normalized URLs.

verifyTls.description: Verify the upstream Pi-hole certificate when apiUrl uses HTTPS. This has no effect on HTTP targets or TLS between the browser and the dashboard front proxy.
